# Check for white selector nodes in the bottom area

            min_row = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
            min_col = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
            max_row = max(p[0] for p in boundary)

    if n['color'] == 'W':

        if boundary:
            min_row = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
            min_col = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
            max_row = max(p[0] for p in boundary)

print("\nBottom sky blue hashes after UP:")
